messages:
alex: heads-up — Clearport is seeing intermittent 5xxs on dedicated-pool-b during the weekend surge, customer flagged SLA risk and wants an ETA
marie: got it. which pool/region and what are the p95/p99 numbers?
sanjay: pinging eng-runtime and eng-platform owners. @olivia can you confirm whether any deploys went out in the last 2 hours?
olivia: no deploys from us. checking infra telemetry now. deploy-bot: Canary rollout started -> 10% (04:12 UTC) — detected 503s at canary nodes :warning:
alex: stats from Clearport traffic: p50 110ms, p95 450ms, p99 ~2.8s. errors spike when KV cache evictions occur under bursts.
marie: thanks. action plan: triage + small config hotfix first, then canary roll. we need owners and ETA.
alex: I opened branch fix/clearport-kvcache-tune and PR #1289 — small retention/ttl changes + extra metrics. needs quick review and backport to 1.3.x.
sanjay: I'll take initial review on #1289. if it's a config tweak we should be able to land fast. I'll also add a targeted unit test.
olivia: infra ready for a short patch window. if merged we can canary to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation windows. we should prepare rollback steps.
alex: minimal sanity test (run locally against staging):
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","input":"test"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq .
```
marie: rollback options: 1) revert canary, 2) route Clearport to cpu-variant model, 3) failover to dedicated-fallback region eu-west-1 for 30m. which is preferred?
sanjay: prefer revert canary as immediate; also prepare routing change if errors persist. I'll include the revert playbook in PR description.
olivia: noted. I'll also stage a temporary routing rule that diverts >95th percentile traffic to fallback region — low-effort, quick.
alex: owners: runtime (sanjay), platform (olivia), oncall (alex). Review ETA: 30m. Canary deploy ETA: 90m if reviews + infra window go smooth.
sanjay: creating PR patch now, will mark as WIP then request reviews. expect first push in ~15m.
marie: I'll coordinate infra windows and slack alerting. @olivia please confirm you'll be available for rollback until 03:00 UTC tonight. :thumbsup:
olivia: I'll stay on-call until 03:00 UTC and monitor canary. will post here when routing rule staged.
alex: deploy-bot — please post canary status updates to this thread once scheduled.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 02:25 UTC — will update this thread with each phase (10%/50%/100%) and health checks.
alex: copying Clearport CS lead on the timeline. keeping this thread for async updates. ping here when review merged or canary status changes.
